album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 1

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D5 and dwells most on D in Chahar-Pare. The line peaks at Ds5 (613.8 Hz) at 0:40.8. It closes on C5, not the tonic (C5 → Ak4 → G4 → C5 → G4 → C5).
